title: The unknown-reads contract lint runs on Linux only

This step's own text says the same. Answer by triage: keep #3005 Windows-only (the lane's own option a, no widening, no departure from main), so no owner question. The lane waits on runner 10 for the lane lint.
note: Drop the Windows run of the lint (the macOS run goes in step ci-mac-once-per-batch). Express under R55 (CI fixes).
